about_the_game:
The flies have acquired occult powers and are determined to end the spider race.

Spider Bounce is a 2d roguelike with platforming and shooting. You control a spider with multiple web types and the ability to fire projectiles.

You'll have a movement web, which you can use to launch yourself across the map and grab flies. There is also an area web, which is better suited for trapping groups of enemies and increasing damage done to them.

Along the way, you'll be able to find and purchase upgrades aiding you in creating your own playstyle and making each run unique.

There are a variety of fly types, each with its own approach to trying to end your life.

Bosses at the end of each world will truly test your skills but also reward you with items if you manage to defeat them.

The game is currently in development and the plan is to include the community in the process through playtests and discussion on Discord (link in the Basic Info tab).

Happy Fly Hunting!

short_description: Spider Bounce is a roguelike action game with freedom of movement. You'll undertake swarms of flies, dodge projectiles and fight tough bosses on a variety of randomised maps. You'll be able to create a unique playstyle by purchasing and collecting items.
